title: Textured Weaving Workshop: Soft Cloud Wall Mini
description:
Preparing the Loom

The loom is set up with evenly spaced warp threads. This creates the base structure for the weaving and keeps all rows aligned and stable.




Weaving the Cotton Base

Thick cotton cord is woven row by row to create a strong, textured foundation. Each row is gently pressed down to keep the weave even and compact.




Adding the First Wool Row

Soft wool roving is placed loosely across the warp threads. This creates a fluffy, cloud-like texture that contrasts with the firm cotton base.




Securing the Wool with Cotton

A new cotton row is woven directly above the wool.
This cotton row is essential — it fixes the wool in place and defines the pattern clearly.




Repeating the Texture Pattern

The process continues by alternating wool and cotton rows, building rhythm, texture, and visual balance in the weaving.




Adding Flow and Movement

Long strands of wool roving are guided across the loom in a continuous motion. This step focuses on rhythm and flow rather than precision, allowing the material to move freely and naturally across the surface.




Completing the Weaving

The final cotton rows are woven tightly to finish the piece. The weaving is now complete and ready to be removed from the loom.



Join this beginner-friendly weaving workshop and create a modern textured wall hanging using thick cotton cord and soft, fluffy fibre rows. This is a calm, hands-on session focused on rhythm and texture, making it the perfect choice if you're looking for something tactile and satisfying to craft in a single sitting.
During the workshop, you'll learn to:
Learn a simple structured base with chunky cotton cord
Add fluffy fibre rows to build a soft “cloud” texture
Get tips on tension, spacing, and neat edges
Finish your piece so it's ready to display or gift
Leave with a completed mini artwork and a repeatable method you can use again
There's no need to worry about the technical side of things, as you'll have guidance through every loop and knot. It’s a low-pressure environment where you can switch off from the digital world and find your flow with these beautiful materials. You'll walk away with a unique handmade keepsake and a newfound sense of creative confidence.

FAQ

Do I need to have jewellery-making experience to participate?
No, it is not necessary to have jewellery-making experience to participate - all you need is enthusiasm and a curiosity to learn about the material! Basic jewellery-making skills will be demonstrated to assist participants.
What will I make at the workshop?
By the end of the day participants will have made two complete pieces of jewellery. These can be of the participant’s own design or designs can be provided. Each participant will be provided with 3.5 grams of silver and 10 grams of base metal for incorporation into their designs.
Are there any health concerns to consider?
Working with horn requires some health and safety precautions to ensure the safe working of the material. Of particular concern is the inhalation of horn dust produced while working horn, which is hazardous to the lungs if inhaled over a prolonged period of time. All participants will be provided with a disposable N95 face mask, which prevents the inhalation of 95% of all airborne particulates. Participants are expected to wear the masks while making takes place in the workshop.

title: One Week Accessory Design Course
description:
This course is tailored for beginners and intermediate-level participants, offering a distinctive group class format designed to assist aspiring designers or those seeking guidance in bringing to life a practical and viable collection of bags and/or accessories.
Through the sessions, you will gain a comprehensive grasp of fundamental skills in accessory design and what it requires to become a bag designer. It empowers you to transform your creative concepts into tangible realities by providing instruction on the essential steps required for prototyping and manufacturing your collection.
In addition to acquiring the skills to design bags and accessories accurately and understanding what information to convey to a prototype maker, this course will guide you through the process of constructing three-dimensional mock-ups for your designs.
Unlike courses that solely focus on creating aesthetically pleasing drawings, this programme emphasizes providing a comprehensive understanding of the intricate and extensive processes involved in designing a collection of handbags. It aims to equip you with the insights necessary to navigate the complexities, ensuring you are well-prepared before and during the design phase. By doing so, the course aims to save you time, expense, and potential frustration when it comes to prototyping and manufacturing your collection.
This course is crafted to assist both emerging and struggling designers in developing and articulating their ideas effectively for the prototyping phase. It addresses the needs and challenges faced by our customers, aiming to support and streamline the creative process for project realisation.
Note: As this is the first time we organise this class in this 2-week format, we might need to readjust some aspects of its structure to ensure it runs at its best. Therefore, we are providing our customers with a discount on the tuition. The class might, for example, end up being a little shorter or longer, and certain topics may be focused on more or less than initially anticipated.
Here's what you'll learn during the classes:
Understanding the role of a bag designer
Before designing: understanding and analysing crucial external aspects that will influence your business success
About your business idea and profile: understanding the target audience, market placement, pricing strategy, and more.
Understanding what a moodboard is and how to use it
Understanding the differences and purposes of illustrations vs technical drawings
Understanding the importance of construction and its impact on your design
Overview of the anatomy of a handbag, lining, and reinforcements
Understanding the structure of a collection: the use of a collection plan
Learning how to plan a balanced collection of fashion accessories
Understanding finishing options for your designs
Understanding hardware and its impact on the cost price of your collection
Overview of leather and vegan leather
Identifying the right materials for your collection
Learning how to draw three-dimensional bags
Sketching technical drawings
Going through the product development of three designs
Developing patterns and realising 1 three-dimensional mock-up of your collection
Providing technical information about your collection to the prototype maker
Understanding the prototyping process
Manufacturing your collection: how it works and what the options are

You will also receive access to a collection of handouts providing relevant information, useful resources, and support in continuing your designing process independently.

A glossary containing essential keywords related to the topic of the lesson

title: Pasta Cooking Course: from Scratch to Sauce
description:
Join this comprehensive pasta making course and learn how to create authentic Italian dishes entirely from scratch. Guided by a chef with over 13 years of experience in Michelin-starred kitchens, you'll gain the confidence to make fresh pasta and sauces in a friendly and supportive setting. This is the perfect activity for anyone wanting to master a new culinary skill.
This course is structured as a four-week programme, with one session per week, but there is also an optional one-day intensive version available if you'd prefer to learn everything in one go. Your instructor will guide you through every step, ensuring you feel comfortable with all the techniques and tools used in this hands-on workshop.
Over the four weeks, you will learn:
Week one: Pasta fundamentals – You'll receive an introduction to essential ingredients and tools and learn how to make fresh egg-based and semolina pasta dough. We will cover kneading, resting, and rolling techniques (by hand and with a machine) before you get hands-on making tagliatelle and pappardelle.
Week two: Shaping techniques – Discover how to cut and shape a variety of short pastas, such as farfalle, orecchiette, and cavatelli. You'll also explore the art of stuffed pastas like ravioli and tortellini, learning about delicious filling ideas before making your own ravioli with a seasonal filling.
Week three: The sauces – This session is dedicated to creating the perfect sauce. You'll cover sauce basics like emulsification and reductions and learn to make classic sauces, including pomodoro, alfredo, pesto, and ragu. To put your knowledge into practice, you'll make gnocchi with sage butter and fresh spaghetti with a tomato-basil sauce.
Week four: Pasta party and final challenge – In your final session, you'll put your new skills into action by cooking a full pasta dish from start to finish. You'll participate in a collaborative pasta bar or a friendly cook-off, followed by taste testing and feedback.
You will leave this course with a certificate of completion and a recipe booklet to continue your practice at home. This experience will fundamentally change the way you cook, equipping you with the lifelong ability to create impressive and delicious pasta dishes for friends and family.

What if some guests don’t eat raw fish?
No problem. There are plenty of cooked, vegetarian, and vegan options. The menu is flexible so every guest can enjoy the experience comfortably

title: Private Wheel Throwing Workshop
description:
Join me for a wheel-throwing class in London where you can explore the art of pottery-making through a private 1-to-2 workshop. This 2-hour session is perfect for both kids and adults keen to learn how to create pottery on a wheel.
Don't worry if you're new to pottery-making. This workshop is designed for beginners, and I'll be there to guide you through the process step by step.
What to expect:
Work with clay on the wheel, getting hands-on experience in shaping and moulding your own creation.
You will have the chance to choose from a range of glazes to add a personal touch to your piece.
Glaze options: dark brown, navy, gloss white, satin cream and pinkish beige.
Work on a unique project from scratch -- a bowl, cup or vase!
One fired piece included in the fee -- if you'd like additional pieces fired, it is £10 per item.
At the end of the class, you will leave with not only the knowledge of wheel-throwing but also with your own handcrafted pottery piece, which you will come and collect 2-4 weeks after. Come on in, roll up your sleeves, and let's get creative with clay in this vibrant and engaging workshop!
What you'll get
All materials and tools to make one bowl, cup, vase or plate!

Beginner-friendly.

An apron and a hand towel.

title: Mindful Macrame Workshop
description:
Join this macramé craft circle in London for a creative reset, using the art of knotting as a tool to regulate your nervous system and find your own rhythm.
Macramé is an ancient fibre art that uses simple knots to create intricate patterns. Beyond the craft itself, the science of making offers a profound somatic reset. The rhythmic, bilateral movements involved in knotting help lower cortisol and gently ease your brain into a restorative flow state. You'll find the repetitive nature of the craft incredibly soothing, making it a great place to start if you're looking to switch off from the outside world.
Here is what you can expect during the workshop:
Begin with a grounding mindful practice to help you settle into the space.
Learn the basic knots required for macramé.
Craft your own unique piece at your own pace using premium materials.
Finish with a reflective practice to help you appreciate the calm you've created.
In this circle, you'll disconnect from your daily roles and allow any perfectionist tendencies to melt away. Whether you prefer to join the conversation or sit in quiet, mindful focus, you're welcome exactly as you are. There's no pressure to be a pro – this is all about enjoying a feel-good way to catch up with yourself or others.
You'll be looked after with teas and snacks throughout the session. By the time you're finished, you'll feel completely recharged and ready to head home with a beautiful handmade keepsake that serves as a reminder of your newfound sense of peace.
What you'll get
A handmade wall hanging.
Tea, bickies and seasonal snacks.
Digital workbook of the basic knots to continue your creative journey.
See booking options

title: Source Breathwork and Energy Healing Workshop
description:
Discover the ancient practice of breathwork and energy healing in this transformative meditation class in London. Led by Charlie Moult, a Breathwork facilitator, Chiropractor and Energy healer, this workshop is perfect for beginners who are curious about accessing higher states of consciousness through breath and meditation.
During the class, you will learn how to use breath to calm your mind and activate your body's natural healing abilities. Charlie will guide you through various breathing techniques and energy work to help you connect to Source energy and your own soul's purpose. You'll leave feeling rejuvenated, clear of mind and empowered to take control of your own well-being.
Set at Our Urban Oasis, a beautiful two-floor organic space, you will feel as though you are escaping the city while still being within it. This consciously-designed space provides a safe and comfortable environment in which to explore your own inner world.
Enjoy delicious adaptogenic tea, coffee by London nootropics as you connect with like-minded individuals. You'll make new friends and feel genuine connections through this shared activity.
This transformative workshop is perfect for anyone who wants to learn how to use their breath to heal, energise and empower themselves. You'll take home new skills and techniques to integrate into your daily routine and continue your journey towards optimal well-being.
What you'll get
Guidance on breathing, learn how to energise yourself and clear your mind.
Enjoy and relax in the incredible studio space.
Refresh with delicious and nutritious food and drinks made from natural herbs and mushrooms.

title: Sound Bath Healing Class and Tea Ceremony Experience
description:
If you want to take away some of the strains of your daily routine, come along to this Kat Bumbal soulful sound healing and music therapy for deep relaxation, stress and pain relief and introspective meditation, followed by a stimulating tea ceremony.
Using the life sounds of gongs, antique singing bowls and other instruments you will learn how to experience the power of sound healing, bringing yourself into a calm meditative mind and enjoy the transaction in a pleasurable manner.
How They Affect Us
The sound of tam-tam type of gongs is quite abstract, containing a wide range of tones and rich overtones, and having very strong resonating properties. Such sound and strong vibrations envelope and penetrate a listener like ocean waves and literally ‘take over’ the mind and the body.
Tea Ceremony
During the tea sessions, you and your fellow participants will sit on the floor and drink exceptional oolong, pu-erh, white or green tea, slowly and mindfully, fully present to the smell, taste, touch. You'll get in tune with all your senses, stop the chatter of your busy mind and experience and live the actual moment. You'll observe and notice the beauty in the simplest things around you, fully satisfying yourself through just being in the space in stillness, present to 'here' and 'now’.
What you'll get
A tea ceremony serving exceptional oolong, pu-erh, white or green tea
Experience sound healing and meditation practise.

No skills required
What to bring
Casual clothes

title: Beginners Yoga Workshop
description:
In this workshop, you will learn how to connect movement with breath during the practice of Hatha yoga. This class begins with a short meditation and breathing exercises, followed by a series of yoga postures known as Asana.
During the Asana practice, we will start with a strategic warm-up, and you will learn the Hatha yoga sun salutation sequence along with other yoga postures. Hatha yoga is a slower and less dynamic practice compared to Vinyasa, allowing us to hold each posture for at least 5 inhalations and 5 exhalations. It is a beautiful and calming environment for beginners to learn and understand the practice.
This class focuses on reconnecting with our bodies and calming our minds in the midst of our non-stop world. It provides the perfect opportunity to learn and experience Hatha yoga in a serene and supportive atmosphere.
By the end of this workshop, you will have gained a deeper understanding of the practice and the ability to connect movement with breath. You will leave feeling more in tune with your body and with a sense of calmness in your mind.
Join us for this transformative experience and discover the beauty and peace that Hatha yoga has to offer.
What you'll get
Instruction and knowledge of basic yoga styles.
Healthy food and drink including adaptogenic coffee, tea and snacks.

title: Mending Workshop - 1-1
description:
Join a creative mending session at Sow Studio in New Cross and learn how to repair and refresh your clothes with skill and intention. This is a welcoming 1-to-1 workshop where you'll be taught different ways to mend your garments, including darning and patchwork techniques. All levels are welcome – whether you've never picked up a needle for mending before or you're looking to develop skills you already have, there's space for you here.
Bring a woven garment you'd like to work on – jeans, a linen jacket, or anything similar – or ask a loved one for an item in need of repair. The patches available range from 3cm to 10cm, giving you options for different types of mends. Over the session, your teacher will show you the techniques step-by-step, working with you on your specific piece.
The real value here is learning skills you can take home and use again and again. By the end of the workshop, you'll have a repaired item you've worked on yourself, a toolkit of mending techniques, and a renewed sense of purpose for your wardrobe. You'll leave equipped to give your clothes a longer, more creative life – turning repair into something meaningful rather than just practical.
It's a chance to slow down, learn something hands-on, and discover that mending your own clothes can be genuinely satisfying.
What you'll get
All materials will be provided for the workshop.

title: Bollywood Dance Choreography Workshop for All Levels
description:
Join this high-energy Bollywood dance workshop in London and discover a joyful way to move, build your confidence, and find your rhythm. Whether you're a complete beginner or simply love to dance for fun, you'll fit right in with this uplifting celebration of expression and community.
Throughout this session, you'll learn a lively piece of choreography broken down into simple, easy-to-follow steps. You'll focus on traditional expressions and rhythm while building your technique and stage presence in a low-pressure environment. With individual attention and a warm, friendly vibe, you'll feel supported as you master the movements.
Warm-up and basic Bollywood movements – Start your session by loosening up and learning the fundamental steps.
Step-by-step choreography – Master a full routine through clear, guided instruction.
Focus on expressions and rhythm – Learn how to bring the dance to life with traditional storytelling and musicality.
Individual attention and friendly vibes – Receive hands-on help in a supportive and welcoming setting.
Performance run-through at the end – Bring everything you've learned together for a final, rewarding dance.
By the end of the class, you'll have experienced a refreshing break from the routine and a real mood boost. You'll walk away with new skills, a sense of accomplishment, and a feel-good glow that lasts long after the music stops.

title: Dreams, Blue Lotus and Sound Healing
description:
Join this expansive morning workshop in London and explore the space between waking and dreaming with dream expert Tree Carr. With years of experience as an author and TEDx speaker, Tree offers a rich, insightful approach to understanding your subconscious. You'll move beyond traditional dream interpretation, blending lucid dreaming techniques with the use of dream-enhancing plants and restorative sound healing.
During this session, you will:
Master lucid dreaming techniques – Learn to recognize when you are in a dream state and engage actively with your inner world.
Participate in a Guayusa tea ritual – Support clarity and dream recall while easing the transition from sleep to wakefulness.
Discover dream-enhancing plants – Explore how to safely use Blue Lotus to support vivid and meaningful experiences.
Experience a sound healing journey – Settle into stillness with crystal bowls and gongs to integrate your subconscious discoveries.
This low-pressure environment is perfect for first-timers looking to switch off and find a moment of mindfulness. Tree will guide you through every step, showing you how to build a conscious relationship with your dreams and develop a deeper awareness of your inner landscape.
You'll leave this session with a newfound sense of empowerment and a toolkit of practices to continue your exploration at home. This feel-good experience will leave you feeling enlightened as you gain a fresh perspective on the subtle intelligence of your own mind.
What you'll get
Mats, blankets, and cushions for your comfort.
Herbal tea to continue your journey beyond the morning.
Each person will be gifted a beautiful Blue Lotus tincture to continue the experience at home.

Please wear comfortable clothing to move freely and rest in.
Avoid heavy meals two hours before the event.

title: Sculptural Keyring Leather Craft Class
description:
Join us for a one-of-a-kind leather work class in London where you will learn the basics of leather craft and create your own unique 3-dimensional sculptural keyring. This 3-hour workshop is designed to introduce you to the art of leather crafting while providing hands-on experience in a fun and engaging environment.
In this leather work class, you will discover a range of shapes and stitch techniques to choose from, allowing you to create a personalized keyring that reflects your individual style. With a variety of colours available, you can select the perfect combination of leather offcuts to bring your design to life.
Don't worry if you're new to leather craft – this workshop is beginner-friendly. Our experienced instructors will guide you through the process, teaching you the basics of decorative stitching techniques and how to mark and cut using leather crafting tools. You will also learn how to insert basic hardware to add functionality and charm to your keyring.
The class will be broken down into different stages, starting with selecting your desired colours and designing your keyring. You will then have the opportunity to cut out your leather pieces and attach the necessary hardware. Finally, with the guidance of our instructors, you will complete the final stitching, giving your keyring a polished and professional finish.
By the end of the workshop, you will not only have a beautiful and unique sculptural keyring to take home but also a newfound skill in leather craft. This hands-on experience will introduce you to the world of leather work and provide a solid foundation for your future projects. So, step into our workshop and let your creativity shine as you embark on this exciting leather craft adventure.
Workshop breakdown:
Select your colours from the offcuts available
Choose your design and stitch technique
Cut out your pieces
Attach hardware
Complete final stitching
Voilà!
What you'll get
Upon arrival, you will be greeted with a soothing herbal tea. All materials are included, and you will leave with a one-of-a-kind keyring.

description:
This Social Collage Workshop is a relaxed, beginner-friendly session that brings people together through creativity and conversation. Participants will explore analogue collage as a way of expressing personal stories, memories, and ideas, using a range of provided materials and optional personal imagery.
The workshop encourages experimentation, connection, and self-expression in a welcoming and supportive environment. With light guidance on materials, colour, and composition, attendees will create their own unique mixed-media collage while enjoying a calm, social space where new connections and ideas can emerge naturally.
Open to everyone, with no experience required. All materials are provided.
By the end of the craft class, you’ll have a beautiful piece of art to take home, filled with memories and stories that reflect who you are. So come along and join us for a fun and inspiring activity!

An original completed artwork on an A4 paper

title: DIY Sushi for Beginners
description: Looking for fun things to do at home? If you love all things sushi, why not try this virtual cooking class? Learn from an expert how to chef-up delicious sushi in the comfort of your own kitchen. You'll be guided on how to prepare rice, cut raw ingredients, wrap, roll and then cut sushi along with other important sushi-making techniques. This cooking class online is perfect if you want some different things to make at home for lunch, snacks, or to show off to friends and family at dinner parties! You will be able to ask any questions you have and get personalised advice from your talented sushi teacher. You'll learn everything from the history of sushi making to modern trends. During this sushi-making class, you'll learn: - How to prepare rice. - How to prepare fresh ingredients. - How to prepare cooked ingredients. - Making perfect maki. At the end of the class, you'll have the skills and knowledge to make perfect sushi at home, you'll also have a selection of homemade sushi to enjoy there and then! If you arrive more than 15 minutes after the scheduled start time, your booking will be cancelled without a refund or reschedule. title: Terrarium Workshop - Create a Botanical World in a Glass
description:
Looking for a relaxing, remote, hands-on creative escape, whether you're at home or in the office?

In this engaging virtual terrarium class, you'll build your own open glass garden using premium succulents or air plants, layered with moss, soil, stones, and decorative elements. With a DIY kit delivered to your door and live guidance from the expert florists at Ferris Heart Sloane, it's a calming way to get creative, connect with nature, and craft something beautiful.

Whether you're planning a remote team-building activity, virtual event, or mindful moment just for yourself, this class offers everything you need to create a thriving indoor plant world – no green thumb required.

Your teacher has taught thousands of students since ClassBento launched in the UK in 2020, including private groups and a who's who of corporate clients.

We use natural, home-grown, locally sourced and seasonal materials wherever possible – helping you create something meaningful with a lower environmental footprint.

Looking to impress? Ask about luxury presentation upgrades and custom corporate options — ideal for client gifting, wellness days, or virtual team socials.

Your experience includes elements of: terrarium, nature, plant care, mindfulness, team building, creative, virtual, DIY kit, indoor gardening

Your teacher is able to ship to the UK, US and Europe.

title: Resin Art Masterclass - Beginners
exact_location: Elstree, South East
description:
Join us for an exciting and transformative resin art class in Greater London. This hands-on workshop is the perfect introduction to resin art techniques, where you'll learn how to create your very own stunning resin art serving tray. No prior experience is required, so don't worry if you're a beginner - we'll guide you every step of the way.

In this workshop, you'll have the opportunity to explore and use basic resin art techniques, all while creating a beautiful and unique serving tray. We provide all the materials you'll need, including epoxy resin, mica powders and pigments, a slate tray (approximately 30 × 20cm), and a heat gun.

The class will start with a safety briefing and demonstrations of resin art techniques, ensuring you feel comfortable and confident throughout the process. You'll then have the freedom to choose your own tints and dyes, allowing you to unleash your creativity and design a resin art masterpiece on the natural slate tray.

After the workshop, your tray will be left to dry overnight and will be ready for collection the next day. Not only are these resin art trays food safe and heat resistant, but they also make a stunning addition to your servingware and homeware collection.

By the end of this workshop, you'll not only have learned the basics of resin art, but you'll also take home your own handcrafted serving tray or wall art, proudly displaying your artistic skills. Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity to learn a new skill and create something truly unique.

title: Mandala Mosaic Design Workshop
exact_location: St Albans, East of England
description:
Learn some mosaic making skills and create your own bespoke mandala mosaic at this relaxing craft workshop in St Albans.

Join expert mosaic teacher, Audrey for a chilled three-hour evening class of creativity and colour. You'll be given lots of support and gain a whole range of mosaic making knowledge, creating your own mosaic mandala to keep. Your finished design will be make a lovely addition to your home or garden!

As you work through your mosaic class, you'll learn all stages of the mosaic making process using a range of vibrant tiles to create a design of your choice.

Working with a wide variety of glass mosaic tiles, you will learn how to create a successful design, how to snip and place your tiles to create an effective design. All materials will be provided and should you not complete your design on the day you'll be given all necessary materials to take home with you and Audrey will be on-hand to support you to complete.

This mosaic making workshop is suitable for complete beginners and those who have experience in mosaic making. The workshop is for adults but also open to children who are keen to attend with a participating adult and who will be happy to participate for the duration. Children 12 years and above enjoy this class best!

By the end of your workshop, you'll have your own mosaic to take home with a small bag of grout and step by step instructions to complete the grouting process at home. You'll also have lots of new mosaic making skills to use for future craft projects.

This would also be a nice gift for her, gift for mum, anniversary gift or birthday gift or a treat for yourself!

title: Mindfulness Clay Workshop
exact_location: Elstree, South East
description:
Join our clay creativity workshop, held in person at Sarah Core Arts' idyllic countryside studio in Elstree, Hertfordshire. These monthly sessions focus on intuitive clay making, perfect for both beginners and experienced potters. Working with clay in this way helps you tap into your creative potential, encouraging an uncomplicated and reflective approach. It’s an ideal activity for learning new skills while enjoying a relaxing and satisfying experience in a non-judgmental setting.

Class sizes are limited to foster a deeper connection between you and the clay, enhancing your creative flow. Each 2-hour session begins with guided relaxation exercises, often with eyes closed, leading into clay activities. The final outcome may be a finished clay item or a series of items.

We use high-quality air-dry clay that can be taken home and decorated with acrylic paints or left at the studio for firing and later collection. Why not book a special glazing social session for those pieces you would like to keep at a later date?

Located conveniently for residents of Watford, Borehamwood, and other Hertfordshire towns, our pottery and wellbeing classes offer a unique, tranquil environment to explore your creativity and enhance your mental wellbeing. Join us to unlock your creative potential and enjoy the therapeutic benefits of working with clay.

title: Beginner's Guide to Crochet
description:
Get hooked on crochet with our beginner’s tutorial! Enjoy this relaxing craft as you get to grips with the simple skills you’ll need to stitch beautiful designs, with one of our craft experts on hand to guide you through the steps. This workshop provides a wonderful introduction to the world of crochet, perfect if you’re a complete beginner.

Through the course of the workshop, you’ll learn double stitch and treble stitch. You’ll also be shown how to create a chain, working in rows to create a tension square. You’ll have a craft kit included, ensuring you’ve got the yarn and hook you need. It’s a great opportunity to pick up techniques you can then put into practice when you move on to other patterns.

Throughout the tutorial, you will be able to ask any crochet questions you may have. 

You’ll be sent a follow-up video afterwards to guide you in your own time.

title: Clay Crafting Experience
exact_location: Bushey, South East
description:
Slow down and reconnect with the pure joy of making in this calming clay workshop in Bushey. You'll unwind through hands-on creativity, exploring air-dry clay, natural textures, and essential oils whilst creating beautiful bespoke pieces to treasure or gift.

This is about relaxation, playful making, and the therapeutic rhythm of working with your hands – not perfection. Whether you're a complete beginner or simply looking for a few mindful hours away from the everyday hustle, you'll feel entirely at home here. In a warm, welcoming space, you'll have time to experiment, explore textures, and genuinely enjoy the calming process of creating by hand.

During the session, you'll make two keepsakes:

- A scented clay bead bracelet or pendant – infused with essential oils and personalised using textures and patterns that reflect your style.
- A handmade clay memory holder – a decorative keepsake designed to hold photographs, notes, affirmations, or meaningful reminders within your space.

All materials and instructions are included, so you just need to show up ready to create, relax, and enjoy the process. Your finished pieces become treasured keepsakes for yourself or thoughtful gifts for someone special.

No experience needed – just bring curiosity and a willingness to slow down.

description:

title: Make an Embossed Notebook Workshop
description:
Discover a new hobby and learn how to make a pewter embossed notebook with this unique online craft class – perfect for those looking for creative things to do at home! Pewter is a pliable, radiant, silvery metal that is easy to engrave or emboss with basic hand-held tools, making it a great base for all sorts of fun and unique designs!

You will be guided each step of the way from a piece of sheet metal to the stunning finished product – so don't worry if this is your first time trying your hand at this unique DIY craft. 

**What to expect:**
- With the help and support of your friendly teacher, you will learn the basics of high and low relief embossing on sheet pewter. 
- During your online class, you will use basic handheld tools and work from tracings and stencils.
- The pewter will then be given an aged appearance and polished to a high gloss finish.
- The finished piece will be used to cover a notebook and a pen. 

By the end of this fun craft class, you will have your very own embossed metal notebook and pen. Head home with your creation and the skills to make more!

title: Beginners Modern Calligraphy Workshop
exact_location: Bushey, South East
description:
Discover a new, mindful activity in this relaxing modern calligraphy workshop. It's an incredibly satisfying skill to learn, and you don't need good handwriting to create beautiful results! This workshop is perfect for anyone looking to learn a creative skill in a calm and friendly environment.

In this 2.5-hour session, you will learn the fundamentals of this beautiful art form. Your friendly teacher will guide you through how to use all the materials before you begin practising the basic strokes that are the foundations of modern calligraphy. Once you feel comfortable, you will move on to forming letters and composing words and phrases.

This is the perfect creative activity to share with friends, family, or co-workers, or simply to enjoy by yourself. You will be amazed at what you can create with just a little bit of guidance.

At the end of the class, you'll have a new sense of artistic accomplishment, leaving with a small completed project and your own set of supplies to continue your calligraphy practice at home.

title: Cricut Beginners 6 Week Course
description:
6 week course includes craft kit worth over £89

Join our fun and creative 6-week Cricut course designed especially for complete beginners! Whether you’ve just bought your Cricut machine or have been too nervous to take it out of the box, this course will guide you step-by-step through the essentials of Cricut crafting in a relaxed and supportive environment. You’ll learn how to use Design Space, work with different materials, and create a variety of beautiful handmade projects while building confidence with your machine each week.

Throughout the course, you’ll explore a range of popular Cricut techniques and projects. In Week 1, you’ll create a stunning giant 3D cardstock rose, perfect for home décor or special occasions. Week 2 introduces heat transfer vinyl as you design and personalise a stylish zipper pouch with an iron-on design. In Week 3, you’ll work with acrylic to create a personalised sign along with a gift box, learning valuable cutting and assembly skills along the way.

As your confidence grows, Week 4 will focus on creating a beautiful layered shadow box frame, teaching you techniques for depth, layering, and intricate cutting. In Week 5, you’ll discover the art of card making, producing custom greeting cards for birthdays, celebrations, and special occasions. Finally, in Week 6, you’ll finish the course by designing and assembling your own custom cake topper — the perfect project to showcase your new Cricut skills.

By the end of the 6 weeks, you’ll have completed a collection of handmade projects, gained practical experience using a variety of Cricut materials and tools, and developed the confidence to continue crafting independently at home. This course is perfect for beginners who want to learn new skills, meet fellow crafters, and enjoy a creative and inspiring atmosphere.

You’ll be sent a follow-up video which will be live for 12 months afterwards to guide you in your own time.

title: Beginner's Guide to Lino Printing Workshop
description:
Explore your artistic ideas in a whole new way by discovering the wonderful craft of lino printing.

Lino printing offers a fantastic way to transform any illustration into a design you can print again and again, perfect for decorating a huge range of projects. Lino printing blocks can be used to apply a design or a repeat pattern to different surfaces and fabrics.

The tutorial is designed for crafters of all abilities but it’ll be ideal for anyone who is new to lino cutting and printing. Hone your skills and enjoy wonderful inspiration, with the support of a craft expert on hand to help you along the way.

The Hobbycraft Artisan will show you how to work with your chosen template, how to cut into the lino tile with your tool and how to get printing with colourful inks. Enjoy mastering the techniques and sparking your creativity as you expand your artistic skillset. 

At the end, you’ll have prints made with your newly cut lino design, ready to show off to friends and family. You’ll be able to repeat the print with your lino tile as many times as you like to personalise gifts, greetings cards and more.

You’ll be sent a follow-up video which will be live for 12 months afterwards to guide you in your own time.

title: Mosaic Workshop in St Albans
exact_location: St Albans, East of England
description: In this immersive mosaic workshop in St. Albans, you will learn the time-honoured technique of creating a traditional Turkish mosaic lamp. Craft a stunning illuminated piece by piecing together hand-cut glass and decorative beads, all while celebrating artistry and cultural heritage. Don't worry if you're a beginner, as this workshop is designed for all skill levels. Your experienced instructor will guide you through each step of the process, ensuring a welcoming and accessible environment for everyone. Step into our authentically decorated studio, where the gentle notes of Turkish instrumental music create a serene atmosphere for creativity to flourish. As you work, you'll be treated to traditional Turkish hospitality—sipping aromatic tea and sampling delicate rose delight. The studio itself becomes part of your cultural journey, featuring displays of musical instruments and traditional coffee-making implements, each with its own fascinating story. Here's what to expect: - Arrive a few moments early to settle in and soak up the atmospheric studio environment - Select your preferred design approach—traditional or contemporary - Learn the careful art of arranging glass pieces and beads to create your unique pattern - Experience Turkish customs and refreshments whilst crafting - Receive clear instruction on the final steps to complete at home By the end of the workshop, you will have crafted a beautifully illuminated Turkish mosaic lamp that will bring warmth and character to any space in your home. This activity not only provides a creative outlet but also offers a meaningful cultural experience that you can cherish for years to come. Your creation will need 48 hours to dry, after which you'll apply the provided grout mixture at home. This crucial step ensures your lamp becomes a lasting piece of functional art. Please note: - The base ticket price is to make a candle holder. You can select different projects at checkout under the 'Add-Ons' menu. - All the lamps are equipped with electricity and they come with a wired-in UK plug. We also provide energy-efficient LED bulbs with lamps. - If you wish to make one lamp between two people, you can also select the 'Accompany Person' add-on. - The duration varies based on the specific project, typically falling between 2 to 3 hours.

title: Watercolour Birth Flower Class
description:
Celebrate your birth flower in stunning watercolour or create a beautiful artwork inspired by a loved one’s birth. This is a great project for marking a new arrival, helping you learn the simple techniques of this timeless art.

Develop your watercolour skills, guided by one of our expert Hobbycraft Artisans. You can choose to follow along with your own materials or book with a craft kit included.

The class will take an online webinar format, giving you the opportunity to watch a live demonstration of the project while also being able to ask any questions. The host will lead you through different watercolour techniques over the course of an hour, taking you through the steps of mixing and layering your colours and adding depth to the piece. 

You’ll be shown all the steps required allowing you to paint along, or you can work on your watercolour piece at any pace you choose.

Simply select your chosen birth flower from the dropdown menu to join the right workshop for you. There are 12 flowers to choose from: snowdrop (January), iris (February), daffodil (March), sweet pea (April), lily of the valley (May), rose (June), waterlily (July), poppy (August), morning glory (September), marigold (October), peony (November) and holly (December).

Top Tip: You only need to purchase the craft kit once as the materials included will cover all of the designs available, book on to additional sessions for £10 each. Each month we will release dates for the next flower.

You’ll be sent a follow-up video which will be live for 12 months to guide you in your own time.

title: Pottery Throwing Experience Workshop
exact_location: Elstree, South East
description:
Join us for a pottery class in Watford at Sarah Core Arts' studio and experience the exciting world of wheel-throwing! In this 2.5-hour workshop, you'll learn how to centre on the wheel and throw a beautiful pot. And the best part? No experience is necessary!

Whether you choose to work on a genuine Leach wheel or an electric wheel, you'll have the opportunity to switch between the two, adding an extra element of fun and exploration to your pottery journey. Our friendly and knowledgeable instructors, Sarah or Rebecca, will guide you through the process, making sure you feel comfortable every step of the way.

A Leach wheel focus (treadle wheel) is available for 1 person sessions. Daunted?  You are not alone.  Some folks struggle with the idea of mindfulness creativity and physical effort working together but working with the treadle wheel allows a slower moment of connection with the what the clay is ‘doing’ might have been missed on the electric wheel. We can work with sensitivity in the way we respond to these moments to allow the pot to progress.  Sarah is with you all the way in this special 121 session.

Don't worry if you're a complete beginner – this workshop is designed with you in mind! The studio will provide all the materials and tools you need to create your masterpiece. You'll work with high-quality clay and glazes, giving your finished piece a professional touch.

Once your pottery is complete, Sarah will fire it to a high standard, ensuring a beautiful finish. You'll be able to collect your creations a few weeks after the session, allowing you to proudly display your handmade pottery at home or give it as a thoughtful gift to a loved one.

Join us on this pottery adventure, and unleash your creativity in a supportive and welcoming environment. Book your spot today and create lasting memories in our pottery class in Watford. Don't miss out on this exciting opportunity to learn a new skill and engage in a fun and rewarding activity! 

Fun and adventure in pottery wheel-throwing sessions. Great for couples! Come to Sarah Core Arts' studio for pottery throwing sessions. There is a choice of working on a genuine Leach wheel (a treadle wheel) or an electric wheel, and the opportunity to switch between the two. Complete beginners are welcome.
